title: Algerian Stilton Flatbread
description: A flavorful flatbread topped with rich stilton cheese, perfect for a quick snack or light lunch.

ingredients.name: flatbread
ingredients.notes: preferably Algerian or North African flatbread

ingredients.name: stilton cheese
ingredients.notes: rich and creamy, a classic cheese choice

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most North African or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Brush flatbread with olive oil and sprinkle with Algerian spice blend.
Top flatbread with crumbled stilton cheese.
Place flatbread in oven and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and season with salt to taste.
